content:
Catch up on Amazon's early Prime Day sale for early autumn and this ongoing $500 discount on the M5 Pro MacBook Pro, today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break headline is the iPhone 17 Pro Max (Renewed Premium) model, up to $513 cheaper than the 18 Pro. We also have ecobee's official early autumn Prime Day HomeKit deals kicking off today, with smart thermostats and bundles discounted up to $210, plus a range of Apple accessory discounts: Solo Loop bands starting at $7, a rare $100 off the Apple Magic Keyboard Folio, and 40% off the official MagSafe external battery. Below are plenty more deals on chargers, TVs, smart speakers and more waiting for you.

Amazon's iPhone 17 Pro Max (Renewed Premium) models now start at up to $513 less than the 18 Pro

We've caught direct deals on the iPhone 17 Pro from Amazon many times, and now paired with early autumn Prime Day deals, we're seeing the first significant discounts on unlocked Renewed Premium models. Even though the iPhone 18 Pro Max is already on sale, you can now pick up a similarly specced 17 Pro for over $500 less. Details below.

The 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Max now starts at $1,385.78 with free shipping, $213 less than the new original price for this model and a full $513 cheaper than Apple's official 1TB 18 Pro Max pricing.

Apple launched the 1TB iPhone 18 Pro Max this month at $1,899. While the 1TB 17 Pro Max didn't sell for that much at launch, with prices having risen, you can now grab a real discount through Amazon's highest quality Premium Renewed listings.

Only the Deep Blue model has dropped this low directly from Amazon; other models are still well below the 1TB iPhone 18 Pro Max's price:

  • Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB, Cosmic Orange (Renewed): $1,499 (original price $1,599)
  • Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB, Deep Blue (Renewed): $1,386 (original price $1,599)

Apple hasn't yet sold the iPhone 17 series in its official refurbished store, and what we're looking at is Amazon's highest quality source, which comes with a full 1-year Amazon Renewed warranty and 'battery performance above 90% of original' — these aren't your typical refurbished units.

Here's the current pricing on Amazon Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (original new price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (original new price $1,299)

M5 Pro MacBook Pro in Silver and Space Gray now $500 off on Amazon

While the latest M5 MacBook Air still has some decent low-price deals, we want to go back and talk about the $500 discount Amazon is offering — both the Space Gray and Silver models of this 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro have been slashed to this deep discount.

Amazon now has the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB storage down to $2,699 with free shipping.

This price matches the lowest we've seen in the past few months, and both Space Gray and Silver are now in stock — the latter usually doesn't get discounted as often as the black.

Apple Solo Loop clearance sale starts: one for $7, two for $10, three for $15 (original price from $49)

To go with the early autumn Prime Day deals, Woot just kicked off a full clearance sale on official Apple Braided Solo Loop and Apple Watch Solo Loop bands. Each band is now just $6.99 with Prime shipping, and buying 'two or more' gets you an extra 30% off at checkout.

We've seen quite a few Apple Solo Loop deals over the past year, but none as good as this one. We expect colors and sizes to sell out fast, so at this price it doesn't hurt to stock up on a few.

The Solo Loop's original price is $49, so even buying just one is a steal. But if you buy two or more and get another 30% off, it's an absolute bargain:

  • Apple Solo Loop $7 (original price from $49)
  • 2-pack Apple Solo Loop $10 (original price from $98)
  • 3-pack Apple Solo Loop $15 (original price from $147)

Colors and sizes are already starting to sell out, so I'll make it brief — place your order while stock lasts.

Rare $100 off Apple Magic Keyboard Folio for iPad lands on Amazon

ecobee official early autumn Prime Day HomeKit deals kick off today: smart thermostats, bundles discounted up to $210

While we're still in early autumn Prime Day mode, thousands of deals have already launched, and ecobee told 9to5Toys that their official Prime Big Deal Days promotion officially starts today. From today through October 7, you can grab deals on their popular HomeKit smart thermostat lineup and bundles (with savings of over $200).

ecobee official early autumn Prime Day deals now live

Although these deals' product pages don't carry the official Prime Day badge, the pricing already reflects the official early autumn Prime Day discounts, many of which match the deals we tracked during the summer Prime Day. Outside of major seasonal promotions, this brand rarely discounts so deeply across so many models, so if you're looking to upgrade your smart home, now's the time.

  • Smart Thermostat Premium $210 (original price $260)
  • Smart Thermostat Enhanced $165 (original price $200)
  • Smart Thermostat Essential $110 (original price $140)
  • Smart Doorbell Camera $120 (original price $160)
  • SmartSensor for Rooms (2-pack) $75 (original price $100)
  • SmartSensor for Doors & Windows $50 (original price $80)

Full bundle discounts:

Nearly every full bundle combo is now matching — or even beating — the summer official Prime Day event.

  • Total Security and Savings Bundle $370 (original price $500) includes Smart Doorbell Camera (wired version), SmartSensor for Doors and Windows, and Smart Thermostat Premium
  • Total Security Bundle 1-Year Smart Security Advanced $375 (original price $580) includes Smart Thermostat Premium, Smart Doorbell Camera, SmartSensors, and 1 year of Smart Security Advanced service
  • Comfort and Security Bundle $245 (original price $340) includes Smart Thermostat Premium, Smart Sensor, 2-pack SmartSensor for Doors and Windows

Twelve South dual USB-C wall plug with Find My slashed to $37 (47% off original price)

Spigen magnetic wrist strap slashed to $15 with Prime shipping

Amazon's new Fire TV Stick 4K now on sale at 50% off today, starting from $16

Along with the currently running early autumn Prime Day deals, Amazon today launched the new Fire TV Stick 4K, and you can get 50% off the regular price by entering promo code 4KINTRO at checkout. This killer launch deal joins early autumn Prime Day discounts on the Fire TV Stick and other streaming devices, starting from $16.

Fire TV Stick early autumn Prime Day deals:

  • New Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K: $30 (original price $60)
  • Amazon Fire TV Stick HD: $16 (original price $40)
  • Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max, Wi-Fi 6E: $45 (original price $85)
  • Amazon Fire TV Cube, 4K Ultra HD, Wi-Fi 6E: $90 (original price from $140)
  • Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Plus, Wi-Fi 6: $38 (original price $70)
  • Amazon Fire TV Alexa Voice Remote Pro: $20 (original price $35)

Amazon now has the new Fire TV Stick 4K with an upgraded Fire TV Remote on sale for $29.99, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

Remember to clip the coupon on the page or enter promo code 4KINTRO at checkout.

The cheapest 15-inch M5 MacBook Air now $100 off, $150 off for the 24GB version

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (original price $1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,399 (original price $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,849 (original price $1,999)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Baseus' new smart display charger for just $43, with a free 100W braided USB-C cable
  • This Baseus 12-in-1 docking station is just $42, and besides elevating your laptop, it adds a full workstation's worth of ports
  • Spacious 55-inch PU leather desk mat slashed to $26 with Prime shipping
  • Samsung 2026 4K/5K ViewFinity Mac-dedicated workstation monitor early autumn Prime Day deal slashes nearly 40%
  • Bring home the roborock 2026 flagship Qrevo Edge 3 Pro robot vacuum and mop, new low of $1,100, more models from $160
  • Add 6 smart bulbs to your Apple Home for just $5 each (30% off)
  • This Anker iPhone external charger has a built-in folding stand, now just $26 (nearly 50% off)
  • New Baseus braided USB-C cable to match the iPhone 18 Pro, starting from $10

Amazon reveals a slew of upcoming early autumn Prime Day deals first

New M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio launch deals return to Amazon (up to $50 off)

Along with this morning's $500 off the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, Amazon is also bringing back all the launch deals on the new M6 Mac mini and M5 Max Mac Studio.

The 2026 Mac mini with the new M6 chip and the high-end M5 Pro models available on Amazon have all been slashed back to their historical lowest prices:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (original price $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (original price $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (original price $1,299)
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (original price $1,699)

The new Mac Studio with 36GB RAM and 512GB storage is also $50 off the regular price:

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,449 (original price $2,499)

It's not a huge discount, but for those looking to upgrade during the early launch period Amazon is now at the lowest price, and since all available models have hit their historical lows, we want to make sure you catch these deals heading into the new work week.
